statement: In 7 of 7 analysed books framed by bedtime or sleep the last spread is quieter than the book's average (0-2 of 5); in non-bedtime books this holds for about half, and many end on a joyful payoff at or above the average. None of the analysed books has a celebration after the story: they close with a picture, a vignette or credits.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books: Book Dash (35), African Storybook (2), StoryWeaver: Pratham Books (5), Room to Read (1); 2014-2026

analyst_note:
2026-10-21: answers the reader agent's question q_what_is_on_the_last_spread_of_the_analys. Two publishers among the 5. Intensity is on the 0-5 research scale; on the engine's 0-3 scale the last bedtime pages are 0-1 (Zuko about 1). Emotion intensity measured 100% re-read agreement (24 pages).
2026-10-28: +2 Book Dash bedtime books, both support: A House for Mouse ends on its smallest picture with a three-word good night (1/5); Clever Pig's last spread is 2 words at 1/5 and the only night-palette spread. Engine scale 0-3: about 0-1. Still mostly Book Dash plus StoryWeaver; the non-bedtime comparison was not recounted this week. Sources of the new works: Book Dash — A Day Out, Who Ate My Hat, Let's Go Looking, Dudu's Hat, Clever Pig, A House for Mouse, Goldfish Genius; StoryWeaver — Get Down, Rocky! (Pratham Books), The Lost Ball (Room to Read, translated from Bangla).
2026-11-13: +1 support: Sweet Dreams (bedtime-framed) ends at 2/5 against a book average of 2.1; its quietest page is the one before (eyes shut, 1/5). Not bedtime-framed but worth noting: I Can Do It! ends on a calm bedtime page (1/5). Sources of the new works: Book Dash — A Trip to the Tap (2023), Going Places (2025), AAAAAHHH!!!! Mmawe! (2024), Can We Eat a Rainbow? (2026), I Can Do It! (2026), Play with Me (2026), Banzi's Busy Bees (2025), Dance, Khuzwayo, Dance! (2023), Alex's Super Medicine (2022); StoryWeaver — Sweet Dreams (Pratham Books, year not shown).

magicpaper.current: After the last page StoryReaderView stops narration and goes straight to StoryEndingLeaf: Ragi waving, 'Masal bitti!', reading counts and a 400 ms celebration, the same in every mode.
magicpaper.suggested: In bedtime mode only: let the last story page stand alone as a quiet moment (no auto-advance, narration ends softly), and make the ending leaf calm: no celebration animation and no reading counts on that screen; keep today's ending for adventure and learning.
